evidence.name: Screen field: Space around the description
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Space around the description" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Space around the description
sections.description: Sets the empty space, in pixels, on each side of the step description: top, right, bottom, left. The default is usually 0; add top padding to separate the description from the subtitle above, or side padding to keep multi-line text off the screen edges. Comfortable spacing makes longer copy easy to read, which keeps visitors absorbing your value and tapping through.
